svg.aria-label: Sheet A-01: Khassida digitization, Arabic glyphs drawn in a type-design grid with the font and OCR bootstrapping loop
svg.title: Sheet A-01: Khassida digitization, Arabic glyphs drawn in a type-design grid with the font and OCR bootstrapping loop
svg.text: OCR and font reconstruction for non-standardized
Arabic calligraphy. The printed edition is aligned
verse by verse with the calligraphy, then OCR and
font improve each other in a loop.
fontTools and HarfBuzz for the font
progress measured in CER and WER
